- Expected scale: pilot ~10k API calls/day, ramp to 100k/day in Q4.
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence, VPC connectivity, procurement timeline.

2) Security & architecture review (VPC, data flows) — Owner: Tom Reynolds (ACME SecOps) / Neha (Redwood SE) — Target: 2026-03-29 — Dependency: access to network diagram & SOC2 docs
3) Pilot deployment + runbook sign-off — Owner: Engineering Lead (ACME: Sanjay Patel) / Redwood Infra — Target: 2026-04-15 — Dependency: endpoint access + test data
4) Production go-live & handoff — Owner: ACME Eng / Redwood CS — Target close: 2026-05-15 (TBD) — Dependency: PO in place

Ask: please confirm stakeholder mapping (economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, eng lead) and whether these targets look feasible. I’ve attached Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx with editable milestones.

Next steps I propose:
- ACME: confirm stakeholder RACI by EOD next week (3/3)
- Redwood: iterate MAP + provide SOW template and estimated TCO (Rishi)
- Schedule security deep-dive with Tom & Neha (tentative week of 3/22)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners and dates.
